<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"siainbuletin"} -->
_Requested by **Sia** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2?thread=cmsg_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW24ZXU9uTRrMUi2hdxaUsWPV)_

## What

- `.github/workflows/tangle-check.yml` and `tools/check-tangle.sh` / `tools/tangle-all.el`: tangle every module doc in CI and fail when a committed `.el` differs from it (whitespace and blank lines ignored). Known drift is in `tools/tangle-drift-allow.txt` (`sp-graphs`, `sp-prog-misc`); the list can only shrink.
- `.emacs-profiles.el`: new `writing` (stable clone `~/src/dotfiles-stable`) and `sandbox` (`~/.config/emacs-modular`) profiles, each with its own `server-name` and `SP_PROFILE`. `default` is unchanged.
- `docs/architecture/stable-and-sandbox-emacs.org`: the setup, promotion to `stable`, watching CI (`gh run`, `gh dash`, Emacs), `emacsclient`, Hammerspoon, the comparison with the Nix-like way and `emacs-pr`, and the other dotfiles. ADR 0022 records the decision.
- The extended tangling text moved from `README.org` to `docs/tangling-instructions.org`; the README keeps a pointer.
- The `stable` branch was created from `main` on GitHub (86b62e0).

## Tested

Emacs 29.3 in a Linux container: `check-tangle.sh` passes on `main` and fails on a committed hand edit of a module. The first GitHub run failed because `sp-dashboard` drifted only in my container (Org indents a string differently between versions); the check now ignores all whitespace and that entry is gone. The profiles, `emacsclient`, Hammerspoon and `gh dash` were not run.

## Open

- `SP_PROFILE` is set but nothing reads it yet (theme, dashboard, frame title).
- Decide the two allow-listed modules.
- Branch name: this PR's branch is `claude/project-thread-3lujh3`, not number-prefixed.
